alignments.note: οὖν → *Now*, the word the ASV writes for the inferential connective.

Correlative μέν left unwritten by the ASV; rule 70 makes it its own `unrepresented` unit and forbids joining it to οὖν, which keeps its own word. A reference comparison will report this as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.
ἦν → *he were*, headed on the verb under rule 9.

οὐδέ *not even* is rendered by the discontinuous *not … at all*, one unit under rule 15 headed on *not*. Confining the unit to *not* and marking *at all* `added` remains defensible; I kept the emphatic phrase whole because it is what the compound negative answers to.
Rule 50: the modal particle takes the English modal auxiliary of the counterfactual apodosis, *would*, and the lexical verb stands alone.
The second ἦν → *he … be*, discontinuous under rule 15, headed on the verb.
Anarthrous ἱερεύς with a supplied *a*, a rule 7 helper under rule 51's anarthrous clause.

Genitive absolute participle: the supplied subordinator *seeing* and expletive subject are rule 7 helpers on the participle, which rule 86 names as a token carrying subordination. Headed on the verb *are*.
Rule 32: the substantival article before a participle supplies the pronoun *those* and nothing else.
The participle carries the relative clause *who offer* under rule 32, headed on the verb.
κατά → *according to*, headed on the prepositional word.

Anarthrous νόμον with a supplied *the*: rule 51's anarthrous clause makes the determiner a rule 7 helper on the noun. The variant unit SBLGNT.HEB.8.4.v004 is underdetermined and its projection reading is realized here, so rule 97 is not in play.

review_notes: μέν is `unrepresented` under rule 70; οὖν keeps *Now* on its own.
οὐδέ takes the discontinuous *not … at all*, with the competing reading named in the note; ἄν takes *would* under rule 50.
